Successful PUT empty response body_dropped is expected unpolled-response coverage, not a failure.
Observed HTTP dispatch-to-headers includes scheduling/network/service waits, not exclusive CPU/disk attribution.
Original RustFS network check coverage remains explicitly incomplete in health receipts.
